traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Acoraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers in spikes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule or berry; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 6; carpels (2-) 3 (-4). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
